_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-07 (grid drawn over the PNG at 13-22x - lines land exactly on tile edges; 192x560 / 16 = 12x35 = 420 frames, no remainder). Forest cave terrain - pairs with forest-autotile for a green-cavern floor variant. TERRAIN: dark-pool (c0,r29, a dark pool with a lavender rim; the only true autotile set on the sheet). ROW-BAND TRIAGE: rows 0-12 cave face - a crystal cave mouth, glowing light, a timbered mine doorway and support frame, ladder, fence, crates and a wagon wheel, over crystal rock-wall and rock-floor variant blocks; rows 13-21 flora and cave props - bushes, pebbles, flowers, mushrooms, stalactites/stalagmites, boulders and gold piles; rows 22-25 sarcophagi, their lids and chests; rows 26-28 four crystal cave-wall variants; rows 29-34 the dark pool, a hollow chasm ring and dark cave-floor fill. Everything not a terrain is a named region in tileLabels.json.
